name: GP Madison Plywood Plant - Madison GA

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to GP's Madison Plywood plant at 1400 Woodkraft Rd, Madison GA, off Hwy 278 NE of town (~33.6165,-83.4220). The roster's geocoded point (33.5775,-83.4768, address '1310 Eatonton Rd') landed ~5 km SW in downtown Madison and was wrong. Coordinates cross-checked against ejmap.org and the Forest Products Locator (both ~33.611,-83.431, near the plant). Plant building centroid locked at 33.61650,-83.42200.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2013-04) at the entrance off Woodkraft Rd clearly shows a red-and-white barrier arm across the truck lane plus a controlled checkpoint with 'Welcome to Georgia-Pacific Madison / All visitors report to security' signage. True.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small staffed guard booth — windows on multiple sides, ~1-vehicle footprint, set beside the entrance lane next to the barrier arm — is clearly visible in Street View. True.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck approach inside the gate before reaching the plant / log yard provides queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal truck approach from the guarded gate to the plant and log yard; ample stacking for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Log receiving (NE log yard) and plywood shipping (W/SW yard and rail load-out) are physically separate operations on opposite ends of the plant.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Plywood plants load finished panels by forklift from open shipping bays rather than truck-height dock doors; a few bays exist. Banded 0-10, low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Yards hold logs and stacked plywood bundles, not parked trailers; no marked trailer stalls.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is operationally expected for a plywood plant with log-truck receiving, but a distinct scale pad could not be confirmed in the available imagery. Marked false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail siding runs along the NW side of the plant with railcars present (gondolas / boxcars).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One dominant plant building plus ~3 ancillary structures (gatehouse, log-yard sheds, shipping/storage); counted 4.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits in open woods/farmland NE of small-town Madison, well away from dense development. Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural but within ~5 km of Madison; coverage likely adequate. False.
